queries.text: A television news frame showing a job fair with blue plastic chairs and recruitment booths, with a headline containing the visible Vietnamese text "VIỆC LÀM".
queries.image_expectation: Job-fair booths, blue chairs and visitors; headline about people visiting an employment exchange.

queries.text: An outdoor bridge-opening ceremony under a red-and-white canopy, with an audience facing a blue stage display bearing the visible text "KINH DƯƠNG VƯƠNG".
queries.image_expectation: Audience seated under red-and-white canopy, blue bridge-opening stage banner. Text alone does not establish the scene.

queries.text: A news frame showing a broad expanse of pale water and a faint distant shoreline, with the visible headline text "NGUY CƠ SẠT LỞ ĐẤT".
queries.image_expectation: Pale water and a distant shoreline with a Hà Tĩnh news headline; do not infer a landslide actually visible.

queries.text: Several large elongated fish swimming in an aquarium under pink-purple lighting, shown close up.
queries.image_expectation: Large aquarium fish under purple lighting. Unrelated news ticker is not evidence about the fish.

queries.text: A male television news presenter wearing glasses, a purple shirt and a tie in an orange-red studio, with the visible ticker phrase "3,2 tấn cá khoai chứa formol".
queries.image_expectation: Glasses, purple shirt/tie, orange-red studio and literal ticker; do not require fish or a truck to be visible.

queries.text: A male television news presenter in a light blue shirt stands beside a large 60 giây graphic, with a ticker containing the visible name "Zhang Zhizhen".
queries.image_expectation: Male presenter, light blue shirt, large program graphic and named ticker; no tennis match needs to appear in the image.

queries.text: A bald man with sunglasses on his head stands inside a shop beside glass display counters, with a visible news headline containing "THUỐC LÁ ĐIỆN TỬ".
queries.image_expectation: Bald man, sunglasses on head, glass shop displays and headline; target OCR was previously observed to corrupt parts of this phrase.

queries.text: A close-up of a brown dog's front paw resting in a person's open hand.
queries.image_expectation: Brown dog paw held by a human hand; headline is not evidence of a specific therapy event occurring.
